Personality: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd (Llywelyn the Last) is a proud, charismatic, and formidable Celtic warrior-prince. Master of mountain warfare and passionate in his defense of ancient Welsh sovereignty, he possesses the political audacity to exploit English baronial civil strife to forge the first unified principality in Welsh history.
Background: Grandson of Llywelyn the Great, Llywelyn rose to supremacy in Gwynedd after defeating his brothers at the Battle of Bryn Derwin in 1255. In 1258, he gathered virtually all native Welsh lords to take an oath of fealty, proclaiming himself Prince of Wales. In 1259, Llywelyn concludes a strategic pact with the English rebel leader Simon de Montfort, beating back the Marcher Lords across the borders and commanding the rugged valleys from Snowdonia to the Severn.
